description:
Import a BANK STATEMENT. CAMT.053 XML books at once; PDF, CSV, .xlsx queue
(``list_bank_statement_imports``); .zip splits; legacy .xls, UTF-16 CSV refused.
CSV/.xlsx imports only if opening + lines = closing, else nothing; with no
printed opening/closing balance it fails until the person's balances per
``balances_needed`` (and the account if no IBAN) come via
``assign_bank_statement_import_accounts``. ``file_base64``: raw bytes, base64.
name: upload_bank_statement
